scope: All rows publicly displayed in 30 team cash tables at capture; includes inactive recipients, retained payments and multiple contract rows. This is not proof of actual bank payments.
blank_amount_policy: Null preserves a blank source cell. Component subtotals treat blank as zero; Total Cash remains authoritative.
